macros.name: pdfoverlayIncludeToLastPage
macros.doc: Output all remaining pages in the PDF file.

macros.name: pdfoverlayIncludeToPage
macros.doc: Output all pages in the PDF file up until the specified page.

macros.name: pdfoverlayPauseOutput
macros.doc: Pause outputting pages from the PDF file.

macros.name: pdfoverlayResumeOutput
macros.doc: Resume outputting pages from the PDF file.

macros.name: pdfoverlaySetGraphicsOptions
macros.doc: Set the options as a comma separated list to be passed to \includegraphics when outputting each page from the PDF file.

macros.name: pdfoverlaySkipToPage
macros.doc: Skip ahead to the specified page number in the PDF file.
